cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description:
Our most popular boat rental!

Our most popular boat with more than 20 in our fleet – the Capri 22 is THE standard for sailing on San Diego’s bays. Our ASA 101 classes are taught on this tiller boat and with an outboard motor.
what_is_included:
- Max of 6 passengers *including children* (4 recommended for max comfort)
- Sailing experience on similar size vessel required - Sailing Quiz required at check-in
- Must be 18+ to rent and operate
- Pets Allowed
- Life vests included (all sizes)
